description:
Whenever a creature enters the battlefield, Hamletback Goliath triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter equals to that creature's power.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1}, creating a 1/1 Servo token.
Hamletback Goliath triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Servo token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Hamletback Goliath triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.
